title: MF GHOST
description: Japan adopts self-driving electric automobiles and renders most gas engines obsolete by 202X. The fastest cars find new life in the MFG, a racing circuit held on Japanese motorways. Drivers from around the world race for a shot at the title. Kanata Rivington returns from Britain to Japan for the MFG—and to find his father. Can he win the title and find answers? Buckle up and push it to the limit!

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Kanata Rivington arrives in Japan from England with the intention of racing in a relatively new motorsports category that's taken the world by storm: MFG.

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Kanata begins his qualifying run around the 40 kilometer-long Odawara Pikes Peak, aiming to set a quick time. But with a seriously underpowered car compared to his rivals, how high up the leaderboard can he get?

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Impressing everyone with his drifting abilities, Kanata aims to finish his qualifying lap with a flourish. But with a long straight just before the line exposing his car's deficiencies, will he make it into the race proper?

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Ren and Kanata continue their tour of Kamakura in the hopes of finding the place where Kanata's parents took their photograph together.

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The two-lap race of Odawara Pikes Peak is underway. With his tires now up to temperature, can Kanata start making his way through the field despite his power disadvantage?

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Kanata zooms up to the back of the Yashi-Kita Gang in no time, but getting past them is another matter entirely. Meanwhile, the two leaders go wheel-to-wheel for the lead of the race.

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: While everyone is suitably impressed with what Kanata is achieving, there are battles up and down the field, and it quickly becomes apparent that the 86 isn't the only car the MFG viewers should be keeping a close eye on.

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: On the approach to the death zone for the second time, Kanata starts to make his move. But does he have enough life left in his tires to climb up the order?

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: After making up a bunch of places in the death zone, Kanata enters the final sector, but with the long straight at the end of the lap highlighting the 86's main weakness, can he hold on to his current position all the way to the checkered flag?

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Kanata managed to haul the 86 up to unexpected heights at Odawara Pikes Peak, but the next race is on a course that is a lot flatter with fewer downhill sections where he can make up for his car's lack of power, so it's time to tune his ride!

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Qualifying begins for the second race of the season, which is set to take place at Lake Ashinoko. With Kanata set to do his run on a later day, other drivers get their moment to shine.

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Ren's mother discovers the secret to Kanata's prodigious talent and the two reminisce about his much-missed mother, Katherine. Meanwhile, Sawatari's monster lap has unsettled the drivers who are still yet to set a time.

episodes_data.title: MF GHOST Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Katagiri Kanata shows what he's made of in the race on the Ashinoko track! With daring drifts through the dangerous "Death Zone," he secures a provisional eighth place despite tough competition and technical challenges.
